name: SOC-010: Windows System Integrity Violation
description: Detects Windows system integrity violations including kernel driver installation (BYOVD), Boot Configuration Data (BCD) tampering, and driver signing enforcement disabling.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%bcdedit%/set%' OR payload ILIKE '%testsigning%' OR payload ILIKE '%nointegritychecks%' OR payload ILIKE '%sc%create%type=%kernel%' OR payload ILIKE '%fltmc%load%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
